scope: New module-augmented architecture search following an unsuccessful original-paper baseline replication; never relabel as exact original DNNABF

module_changes.input: AOA-only interface followed by positive relative spatial phase features, role and validity masks
module_changes.output: unbounded linear head followed by centrohermitian and distortionless projection; no tanh bound on final weights
module_changes.supervision: raw sample MVDR weights, no clipping or per-vector scaling
module_changes.loss: plain component MSE in a unitary canonical coordinate system, equal to physical-coordinate MSE
module_changes.inference: no covariance inputs, inverse, solve, eigendecomposition or teacher correction

planned_search.updates: one training-weight step then one architecture-validation step after warmup
planned_search.width_selection: outer macro-space comparison; FF neuron counts and depth/modules selected by DARTS within each macro space
planned_search.execution_status: pilot first; full search matrix not launched

required_controls: original fixed DNNABF reproduction already archived separately
fixed DNNABF hidden widths with identical new modules and training settings
random architecture in selected search space without test-based resampling
selection_policy: Weight/architecture optimization and checkpoint/architecture selection use development splits only. No test is generated by the pilot.

future_test.pointing: retain absolute input-AOA error and separate NN-versus-MVDR peak agreement; do not replace one with the other
